record.t: Was designated acting lieutenant governor of Hawaii by Governor Josh Green, following Lieutenant Governor Sylvia Luke's decision to take a leave of absence.
record.q: Governor Josh Green today announced the designation of Keith Regan, comptroller of the Department of Accounting and General Services (DAGS), to serve as acting lieutenant governor for the state of Hawaiʻi, effective immediately, following Lieutenant Governor Sylvia Luke’s decision to take a leave of absence.
